image_description: A low-resolution, vintage-style photograph featuring two white daisies with yellow centers against a dark, high-contrast background. The flowers are supported by thin green stems, accompanied by blurry foliage and grass blades. The image has a grainy texture and soft focus typical of older film photography.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both visible flowers clearly exhibit the classic daisy structure: a distinct yellow center surrounded by white radial petals.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flower head is modest in size with numerous elongated white petals radiating outward.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The petals are elongated and radiate correctly from the center. The count appears consistent with natural variation for this species.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the centers are yellow, the 'bumpy, granular texture' is not visible due to the low resolution and blur of the image. The centers appear as smooth yellow blobs rather than textured discs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Petals narrow, slightly pointed, arranged in flat, circular pattern.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The petals are narrow and taper to points. The arrangement is radially symmetric and flat.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Slender green stem supporting flower head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Thin green stems are visible connecting the flower heads to the lower vegetation.
The foliage is extremely blurry and indistinct. It is impossible to definitively identify specific leaf shapes or their attachment pattern (alternate vs. opposite) on the stems.
The bottom of the frame cuts off the stems before they reach the ground/soil line. The base is outside the field of view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Single stem supporting composite flower head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Each flower head is supported by its own individual stem structure, consistent with daisy morphology.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Central disc florets form textured yellow center.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Duplicate of the texture checkpoint above. The resolution prevents verification of individual floret texture.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Significant motion blur or out-of-focus blur affects the background and lower half of the image. While this may be an artistic choice or camera limitation, it reduces structural clarity.
Heavy grain/noise and low resolution obscure fine details. This is characteristic of old film or aggressive compression, but acts as a visual artifact masking true texture.
The long leaf-like structure on the right side blends ambiguously into the background. Its connection point is unclear, suggesting slight geometric ambiguity common in AI generation or poor focus.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification despite low resolution and verify it is not a look-alike composite flower.
To distinguish between intentional vintage aesthetic (film grain, blur) and AI-generation artifacts (smearing, unnatural noise patterns).
To check if the petals merge cleanly with the center disc or if there is edge bleeding/fusion typical of generative models.
To analyze the depth relationship between the sharp flowers and the blurred background to ensure physically consistent defocus.

focus_areas: Distinction between film grain and AI noise
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'blur' artifact. Determine if the lack of detail in the center disc is due to image quality (acceptable) or generative failure (unacceptable). Verify if the background blur follows a logical depth map or if it looks like random smearing.
